aboutpalau.title: Pristine Paradise Palau
aboutpalau.subtitle: Explore Pristine Paradise Palau, the pearl scattered by God in the Pacific Ocean.
aboutpalau.pledge_intro: Palau is the first nation on earth to change its immigration laws for the cause of environmental protection. Upon entry, visitors need to sign a passport pledge to act in an ecologically responsible way on the island.
aboutpalau.pledge_content:
"Children of Palau, I take this pledge,
as your guest, to preserve and protect your beautiful and unique island home.
I vow to tread lightly, act kindly and explore mindfully.
I shall not take what is not given.
I shall not harm what does not harm me.
The only footprints I shall leave are those that will wash away."
aboutpalau.geo_desc: Located in the Western Pacific, composed of more than 340 volcanic and coral islands, divided into 16 states.
aboutpalau.heritage_desc: The Rock Islands Southern Lagoon was listed as a UNESCO mixed World Heritage site (natural and cultural) in 2012.
aboutpalau.culture_desc: Palau has a rich matrilineal society culture. The traditional men's meeting house 'Bai' is the center of tribal council, and the paintings on the roof tell ancient legends.
aboutpalau.climate_desc: Tropical oceanic climate, average annual temperature 28~32°C. Summer all year round, occasional showers, rainbows often appear after rain, hence the reputation of 'Rainbow Hometown'.
aboutpalau.wonders_desc: Named No. 1 of the 'Seven Underwater Wonders of the World' by CEDAM International.

tours.combos_desc: One-stop service including selected accommodation and classic tours, letting you enjoy your vacation without worries.
tours.combos_full_desc: We have carefully selected the most comfortable accommodation in Palau for you, paired with the most classic tour itineraries. Whether it's snorkeling, visiting Jellyfish Lake, or enjoying a lunch on an uninhabited island, we have arranged everything for you. Airport transfer and exclusive guides ensure a worry-free journey.
tours.day_tours_desc: Selected most popular attractions in Palau, Big Drop Off, Jellyfish Lake, Milky Way, all in one day.
tours.day_tours_full_desc: Limited time? No problem! Our day tour takes you to the must-visit attractions in Palau. Admire the spectacular coral reefs at the Big Drop Off, dance with non-toxic jellyfish at Jellyfish Lake, and enjoy a natural volcanic mud SPA at the Milky Way. The itinerary is compact and rich.
tours.sup_desc: Paddle SUP through the hidden gems of the Rock Islands, enjoying the tranquility and magnificent natural scenery.
tours.sup_full_desc: Stay away from the hustle and bustle, paddle SUP deep into the mangroves and lagoons of the Rock Islands. Glide on the calm water, listen to the insects and birds, and feel the breath of nature. Professional coaching ensures that even beginners can get started easily.
tours.photo_desc: Professional photographers accompany you to record every wonderful moment and leave the most beautiful memories.
tours.photo_full_desc: Rarely come to Palau, how can you not leave beautiful photos? Our professional photography team will accompany you to shoot, whether it is underwater heroic posture or land beauty, capturing it perfectly for you. Drone perspective is provided to make your memories more three-dimensional and shocking.

preparation.title: ✈️ Preparation & Visa
preparation.visa_content: Holders of ROC passports valid for more than 6 months enjoy 90 days visa-free entry.
preparation.alert_title: Important: Protect the Ocean, Start with Sunscreen
preparation.alert_content_1: Chemical sunscreen prohibited: Palau is the first country to ban reef-toxic sunscreen. Import or sale will result in confiscation and a US$1,000 fine.
preparation.alert_content_2: Please use 'Reef Safe' sunscreen or wear long-sleeved rash guards.

entry.title: 🛃 Entry Requirements
entry.ppef_content: All visitors to Palau must pay a US$100 Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee.
entry.ppef_note: Usually included in your airline ticket, no need to pay on arrival.
entry.pledge_content: Upon entry, a 'Palau Pledge' stamp will be placed in your passport. You must sign it to pledge to protect the environment during your stay.
entry.form_content: Fill out the 'Customs Declaration' and 'Arrival Card' online within 72 hours before departure.

customs_list.ecig: E-cigarettes: Strictly prohibited. Fines or confiscation apply.
customs_list.cash: Cash: Do not carry more than US$10,000.

life.title: 💰 Local Life Info
life.money_content: Suggested cash: US$300~500. Credit cards accepted in malls, but most shops prefer cash.
life.network_content: Internet: No signal at sea. SIM card approx US$20 for 5 days unlimited data.

tips_list.porter: Porter: US$1 per person per time
tips_list.housekeeping: Housekeeping: US$1 per room per day
